citation: 95 Phonics Core Program — Evidence Rating. (2024). https://www.95percentgroup.com
title: Structured scope-and-sequence lesson pattern with daily 20-30 minute explicit phonics instruction
description: The program organizes instruction around a scope and sequence of lessons per grade — 25 lessons for Kindergarten and 30 lessons for each of Grades 1-5. Each lesson "focuses on specific phonics skills, provides examples of high-frequency words, and contains information about other skills addressed within the topic," delivered in short daily sessions of 20-30 minutes.
requirements: Teacher's edition, student workbooks, manipulatives, and digital presentation files per grade kit
constraints: Instruction is designed to fit a 20-30 minute daily period, which teachers in one study reported was sometimes challenging to fit without minor adaptations
target_learners: Kindergarten through fifth grade students in whole-class instruction
target_learning_goals: Sequential phonics skills such as short vowel CVC, consonant blends, consonant digraphs, long vowel silent-e, and phonograms
examples: The First Grade Scope and Sequence disaggregates 30 lessons into seven topics: Introduction, Short Vowel CVC, Consonant Blends, Consonant Digraphs, Long Vowel Silent-e, Phonograms, and Introduction to Second-Grade Skills.
